# FirstFlip API

> FirstFlip business API integration documentation, OpenAPI contracts, scoped-key MCP tools and a portable integration skill.

Public documentation does not grant API access. Business keys, scopes, verification and per-service controls govern requests. Test keys simulate supported operations; consult each operation's guide for live prerequisites. Fulfil payments from verified events or API status, never from a browser redirect.

## Start here

- [API overview](README.md)
- [OpenAPI contract](openapi.yaml)
- [Services contract](api/services.openapi.json)
- [Agent capability manifest](.well-known/firstflip-integration.json)
- [Generated tool catalog](agents/tools.json)
- [Portable integration skill](skills/firstflip-integration/SKILL.md)
- [Complete guide context](llms-full.txt)
